title: Good experience 🏄‍♀️🏄‍♂️
text: An incredible experience renting the paddle surf equipment. Everything was in perfect condition and the process was very easy. Miguel, the instructor, was very kind and explained everything clearly and professionally, which made us feel safe from the very first moment. Without a doubt, we would do it again.
author: T7894HW_

title: TO BE REPEATED!!! SAFE AND BEAUTIFUL
text: I wanted to have an experience different from the usual ones that are done here in Seville, and I found this company that rents kayaks and SUPs, and I came with my friends. They explained all the rules of how to use them and the route that could be done in an hour and a half/two. We took the guide for an additional cost to the rental, but I recommend it because it is nice to hear the history of the city and the river while you are there. I recommend it to everyone, especially because it is very safe even for families.
author: 672giuliaz

title: Friendly and informative
text: Great and friendly tour guide. Helped me all the way and with a smile.
author: Vinkal M

title: Lovely way to see the city
text: Our family through enjoyed our kayaking tour, perhaps mostly because of our amazing guide, Ginez.  Finding the launch location was a little complicated and therefore we were a little late and then there was a slight mix up about payment. But, Ginez was so gracious throughout.  He made sure we felt taken care of and it is so obvious he enjoys his city and showing people around.  We have kayaked in other cities and it is such a wonderful way to see a different side of the architecture. Don’t miss this experience.
author: kpsonthego
